positions.as_written: Recognise posterior root tear as a distinct entity rather than as a posterior horn tear.
Repair aims to restore the footprint, so fixation is placed at the anatomical attachment and not simply nearby.
In a posterior root tear with a correctable varus deformity, address both.
In combined cruciate and root pathology, plan tunnel position with the root footprints in mind, because the space is shared.
Repair or resect a posterior root tear.
